I need to make a Monopoly decision.

I have $529 and four properties, but no monopoly yet. I own two greens and still need Pennsylvania Avenue. Player 1 has $606 and several monopolies.

Player 3 has $1435 and Player 4 has $1750. Neither owns Pennsylvania Avenue, so I cannot trade for it. Mortgaging is not worthwhile.

I cannot trade for Pennsylvania Avenue because it is unowned. I also cannot complete the Mediterranean set. Purchasing another railroad would cost too much and leave me short of cash to buy PA Ave if I land on it.

I can afford Pennsylvania Avenue with roughly $209 left over. I cannot trade to complete another player's set because I lack the missing pieces. Selling assets is unnecessary.

I will conserve cash and end my turn. I want to land on Pennsylvania Avenue, Park Place, Boardwalk, Reading Railroad, Baltic Avenue, or New York Avenue to block player 1. I should not trade with the other players because they are both cash-rich and could buy up properties.

I will not trade Mediterranean Avenue for a railroad. It is too weak to complete a set, and Baltic Avenue is unowned but could be a cheap future acquisition. Pacific Avenue and North Carolina Avenue are my best assets and should stay. I will keep the B&O Railroad.
